   127	    def compile(self, node, scope):
   128	        head = node[0]
   129	        if head == 'var':
   130	            name = node[1]
   131	            return Var(scope[name], name)
   132	        if head == 'const':
   133	            node_type = self.types.get(node[1])
   134	            return Const(node_type, convert_constant(node_type, node[2]))
   135	        if head == 'field':
   136	            operand = self.compile(node[1], scope)
   137	            inner = Type.inner(operand.type)
   138	            name = node[2]
   139	            return Field(inner.fields[name], operand, name)
   140	        if head == 'index':
   141	            operand = self.compile(node[1], scope)
   142	            inner = Type.inner(operand.type)
   143	            index = node[2]
   144	            return Index(inner.element_type, operand, index)
   145	        if head == 'all':
   146	            binding = node[1]
   147	            operand = self.compile(node[2], scope)
   148	            inner = Type.inner(operand.type)
   149	            inner_scope = dict(scope)
   150	            inner_scope[binding] = inner.element_type
   151	            body = self.compile(node[3], inner_scope)
   152	            return Forall(Bool(), operand, body, binding)
   153	        if head == 'match':
   154	            operand = self.compile(node[1], scope)
   155	            return Match(Bool(), operand, compile_pattern(node[2]))
   156	        if head == 'not':
   157	            return Not(Bool(), self.compile(node[1], scope))
   158	        operation = canonical_op(head)
   159	        if operation in BINOPS:
   160	            left = self.compile(node[1], scope)
   161	            right = self.compile(node[2], scope)
   162	            if operation in ('add', 'sub'):
   163	                node_type = Type.inner(left.type)
   164	                if not isinstance(node_type, Int):
   165	                    node_type = Type.inner(right.type)
   166	                return Binop(node_type, operation, left, right)
   167	            return Binop(Bool(), operation, left, right)
   168	        raise ConfigError('unknown expression form ' + repr(head))

   194	class Application(object):
   195	    """One composed filter application: a filter plus its own binding."""

   197	    __slots__ = ('module', 'parent_env', 'mapping', 'env', 'predicate')
   198	
   199	    def __init__(self, module, parent_env, bind):
   200	        self.module = module
   201	        self.parent_env = parent_env
   202	        self.mapping = bind
   203	        self.env = {}
   204	        self.predicate = module.requires
   205	
   206	    def evaluate(self):
   207	        env = self.env
   208	        parent = self.parent_env
   209	        for (name, source) in self.mapping:
   210	            env[name] = parent[source]
   211	        return self.predicate.evaluate(env)

   226	class MachineModel(object):
   227	    """Recorded state machine plus its compiled transition guards.
   228	
   229	    Guards are evaluated on the recovered entry inputs of one record, so all
   230	    guards of a campaign share a single environment holder: it is repointed at
   231	    the current record once, and every guard closure then reads through it.
   232	    Guard predicates that read no variable are folded once, which keeps a
   233	    guard-heavy machine cheap even for thousands of records.
   234	    """
   235	
   236	    __slots__ = ('states', 'index', 'initial', 'state_param', 'message_param',
   237	                 'graph', 'preparer', 'sources', 'compiler', 'scope', 'holder',
   238	                 'template', 'dynamic')
   239	
   240	    def __init__(self, document, compiler, scope):
   241	        self.states = list(document['states'])
   242	        self.index = {name: position for position, name in enumerate(self.states)}
   243	        self.initial = document['initial']
   244	        self.state_param = document['state_param']
   245	        self.message_param = document['message_param']
   246	        self.compiler = compiler
   247	        self.scope = scope
   248	        self.holder = [{}]
   249	        self.template = None
   250	        self.dynamic = None
   251	        edges = []
   252	        sources = []
   253	        for transition in document['transitions']:
   254	            when = transition['when']
   255	            if when is None:
   256	                guard = -1
   257	            else:
   258	                guard = len(sources)
   259	                sources.append(when)
   260	            edges.append((transition['from'], transition['to'], transition['cost'],
   261	                          transition['command'], guard))
   262	        self.sources = sources
   263	        self.graph = MachineGraph(self.states, self.initial, edges)
   264	        self.preparer = self.graph.preparer()
   265	
   266	    def compile_guards(self):
   267	        template = bytearray(len(self.sources))
   268	        dynamic = []
   269	        for position, source in enumerate(self.sources):
   270	            expression = self.compiler.compile(source, self.scope)
   271	            if HasVar().visit(expression):
   272	                dynamic.append(
   273	                    (position, compile_closure(expression, self.holder)))
   274	            elif Evaluator({}).visit(expression):
   275	                template[position] = 1
   276	        self.template = bytes(template)
   277	        self.dynamic = tuple(dynamic)
   278	
   279	    def mask(self, env):
   280	        """The enabled-transition mask for one recovered record."""
   281	        if self.template is None:
   282	            self.compile_guards()
   283	        dynamic = self.dynamic
   284	        if not dynamic:
   285	            return self.template
   286	        self.holder[0] = env
   287	        result = bytearray(self.template)
   288	        for position, closure in dynamic:
   289	            if closure():
   290	                result[position] = 1
   291	        return bytes(result)

   294	class Campaign(object):
   295	    """The compiled campaign plus its replay driver."""
   296	
   297	    def __init__(self, document):
   298	        if not isinstance(document, dict):
   299	            raise ConfigError('campaign must be a JSON object')
   300	        self.types = TypeTable(document.get('types') or [])
   301	        self.compiler = PredicateCompiler(self.types)
   302	        self.modules = {}
   303	        for item in document.get('modules') or []:
   304	            self.modules[item['name']] = self._module(item)
   305	        self.graph = DependencyGraph()
   306	        for name in self.modules:
   307	            self.graph.add_node(name)
   308	        for (caller, callee) in document.get('calls') or []:
   309	            self.graph.CallEdge(caller, [callee])
   310	        self.pipes_by_target = {}
   311	        for item in document.get('pipes') or []:
   312	            pipe = PipeModel(item['target'], item['filter'], item['bind'])
   313	            self.pipes_by_target.setdefault(pipe.target, []).append(pipe)
   314	            self.graph.CallEdge(pipe.target, [pipe.filter])
   315	        self.entries = list(document.get('entries') or [])
   316	        self.runs = list(document.get('runs') or [])
   317	        machine = document.get('machine')
   318	        self.machine = None if machine is None else MachineModel(
   319	            machine, self.compiler, self._guard_scope())
   320	        self.contexts = []
